run_multi_modal_inference_cli: run multi-modal inference on an image with a text prompt using the Llama vision model via CLI
launch_gradio_ui_vision: launch a Gradio UI for interactive multi-modal inference with the Llama vision model and chat history
load_model_with_lora: load a Llama vision model and processor with an optional LoRA adapter from a finetuning path
generate_text_from_image: generate text from an image using the Llama vision model with configurable temperature and top-p sampling
process_image_input: process and validate an image input from a file path or PIL Image and convert to RGB
